findings.current: For a command center assembled in only a few days, the main headquarters had managed to build an impressive structure and amass tremendous forces.
findings.defect: Turns the main force’s command organization into a command center and makes its organizational system sound like a physical structure.
findings.rationale: 본대 지휘부 refers to the main force’s command; 짜임새 있는 체계 is its coherent organization.
findings.replacement: Though the main force’s command had been assembled in only a few days, it had established a well-organized system and amassed tremendous fighting strength.
findings.source: 본대 지휘부는 불과 며칠 만에 편성된 것치고는 짜임새 있는 체계와 엄청난 전력을 구축할 수 있었다.

findings.current: “I knew Siegfried, even if we weren’t close, so I could’ve taken him out easily. But given how reclusive Siegfried was… who knows? It would’ve been close to impossible.”
findings.defect: Leaves Hagel’s easy access and the near-impossibility sounding contradictory, obscuring that the obstacle applies to someone Siegfried did not know.
findings.rationale: Hagel contrasts his existing acquaintance with the difficulty of approaching the reclusive Siegfried without one.
findings.replacement: “I’d met Siegfried, even if we weren’t close, so I could’ve taken him out easily. But for someone he didn’t know, given how reclusive he was? That’d be close to impossible.”
findings.source: 나야 친하진 않더라도 면식이 있는 상태니까 손쉽게 처치할 수 있었겠지. 하지만 지크프리트의 폐쇄적인 성향을 생각한다면, 글쎄. 거의 불가능에 가까워.

findings.current: “The Prophet was someone Siegfried knew personally.”
findings.defect: Implies a closer relationship than the mere prior acquaintance needed for Hagel’s explanation.
findings.rationale: 일면식 indicates that they had met, not necessarily that they knew each other personally.
findings.replacement: “The Prophet was someone Siegfried had met before.”
findings.source: 아니면…… 놈의 정체가 지크프리트와 일면식이 있는 누군가거나.

findings.current: At Team Leader Choi’s cautious question, Chuck Hagel clicked his tongue.
findings.defect: Changes a lip-smacking gesture into a tongue click, suggesting a different reaction.
findings.rationale: 입맛을 다셨다 describes smacking or wetting one’s lips.
findings.replacement: At Team Leader Choi’s cautious question, Chuck Hagel smacked his lips.
findings.source: 최 팀장의 신중한 질문에 척 헤이글이 입맛을 다셨다.

findings.current:
Caught in the pressure, the sand rose into the air and was cut apart as they hacked at the enemy who had killed their precious comrade.

Or so they thought.
findings.defect: Says the Hunters hacked at the enemy; the source says they cut the rising sand and only thought they could cut the enemy down.
findings.rationale: The sand is what their blades actually cut; striking the enemy remains an expectation overturned by the next attack.
findings.replacement:
They sliced through sand thrown up by the force of their swings, certain they could hack apart the enemy who had killed their precious comrade.

Or so they thought.
findings.source:
풍압에 휩쓸려 솟아오른 모래를 베고, 소중한 동료를 죽인 적을 난도질했다.

아니, 그럴 수 있을 것이라 생각했다.

findings.current: Hundreds dwindled to a hundred, and a hundred to dozens. It took barely ten minutes.
findings.defect: Barely ten minutes suggests ten or fewer, rather than a little over ten.
findings.rationale: 십여 분 남짓 places the duration just over ten minutes.
findings.replacement: Hundreds dwindled to a hundred, and a hundred to dozens. It took only a little over ten minutes.
findings.source: 수백이 일백으로, 일백이 수십으로 줄어들기까지 걸린 시간은 불과 십여 분 남짓.

findings.current: A gulf so great that he couldn’t even flee in fear. So great that he couldn’t swing the sword he’d drawn.
findings.defect: “Flee in fear” suggests flight driven by fear, whereas fear has immobilized him.
findings.rationale: 겁에 질려 makes terror the reason he cannot flee or use his sword.
findings.replacement: He was too terrified to run. Too terrified even to swing the sword he’d drawn.
findings.source: 겁에 질려 도망칠 수조차 없을 만큼. 뽑아 든 검을 휘두를 수조차 없을 만큼.

findings.current: Beneath the hood pulled low over his face, the figure’s lips curled gently upward.
findings.defect: Assigns the intentionally indistinct Prophet a masculine pronoun absent from this description.
findings.rationale: The source describes the robe and visible mouth without specifying the Prophet’s gender.
findings.replacement: Beneath the low-drawn hood, the figure’s lips curled gently upward.
findings.source: 깊게 눌러쓴 로브 아래로 드러난 입꼬리가 부드럽게 솟구친다.

summary: Several passages alter how Siegfried could have been approached, what the Hunters actually struck, or the timing and force of the scene.
